title: Dino Island 3D
description: Explore a vibrant 3D prehistoric island, hatch adorable dinosaurs, gather resources, unlock new enclosures, and expand your bustling Jurassic park empire.
controls: Drag the virtual joystick to move your explorer around the island, harvest resources, and step onto unlock pads to build dinosaur habitats.

zh-CN.title: 恐龙大陆 3D 经营
zh-CN.description: 3D 史前恐龙岛模拟经营：探索神秘大陆、孵化呆萌恐龙、采集资源扩建园区，亲手打造人山人海的侏罗纪乐园！
zh-CN.controls: 滑动虚拟摇杆控制主角在岛上移动采集资源，踩踏解锁区域不断建造恐龙栖息地扩建乐园。
